# ADR-0008

Cites two things that are not citable tests. Both must stay unresolved — before
and after 0105 — or the fix has widened what an ADR may cite.

## Enforcement

| Clause    | Tier | Mechanism                                   | Status |
| --------- | ---- | ------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| templated | 1    | vitest · `it('a templated guarantee %s')`   | gated  |
| a suite   | 1    | vitest · `it('a suite that is not a test')` | gated  |
